div.head: Iud Dei VII Inscr.
div.ab: Incipit exorcismus aquę — — offerre = Iud. Dei I Inscr.—1, 1, o. S. 401.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 413 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page); Liebermann’s heading: [VII.]; F: corrected against Liebermann, Gesetze I (date at the head of the text); Wormald, Making of English Law I; Whitelock, English Historical Documents I, October 2026 (was “c. 950–1050 (Liebermann)”, now “c. 950–1050 (Liebermann, I p. 413)”)

note.seg: Hs. Ci p. 301; auch Vt f. 13 enthält 12—12, 4; 12, 1 A—4 A; 13; 13 A. Vgl. über Ci Vt o. S. 401ᵇ. Der Übersetzer schreibt Westsächsisch um 1000; von seinen Abschreibern lautet manchmal Ci, seltener Vt etwas jünger.

MS Ci p. 301; Vt f. 13 also contains 12—12, 4; 12, 1 A—4 A; 13; 13 A. On Ci Vt cf. above p. 401ᵇ. The translator writes West Saxon of c. 1000; of his copyists, Ci sometimes, Vt more rarely, has somewhat later forms.
